items.name: Engineering / platform lead
items.notes: Owns the governed path today. Decides whether the new default replaces or sits beside the existing one.

items.name: Non-engineering builder
items.notes: The actual target user. If someone outside engineering cannot ship without help, the evaluation has not proved anything.

items.name: Data platform owner
items.notes: Owns warehouse access patterns. Validates that apps reach production data with scoped, auditable credentials.

items.name: Security reviewer
items.notes: Reviews identity, secrets handling, network egress, and audit posture against internal standards.

items.name: Finance / procurement
items.notes: Confirms seat model, cost attribution, and how spend is tracked per team once the estate grows.
